sections.body: SEO work starts with understanding the website, the search landscape and the pages most likely to support business goals. Priorities are then organized into practical actions rather than disconnected tasks.

items.title: What this can include
items: On-page titles, meta descriptions, headings and content recommendations
Internal linking and content structure improvements
Technical SEO checks for crawlability, indexability, canonical tags and sitemap coverage

items.title: How I approach the work
items: Review the current website and available search data
Identify issues and opportunities by impact and effort
Implement agreed updates or coordinate with the developer
Measure changes using Search Console and analytics data

sections.heading: Need support with this service?
sections.text: Tell me about your business, current website and goals. I can suggest practical next steps based on your needs.
